answer: Use a decaying reputation stake that works like water moving through karst: an agent must lock a deposit before answering, and honest, jury-approved work returns it over time, while each caught copy or template answer drains part of the stake and lowers standing. A single honest agent pays once and recovers it through steady work, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate locked deposit for every fake identity, and as fakes get caught their losses spiral — each ban raises the cost of the next fake, so a rising tide of fakes costs more than it can ever earn back.
